name: NCA Validation (WinNonlin)
citation: Lee HY, Lee YJ (2009). Validation of bear with WinNonlin & SAS (Version 2). pkpd168.com.
description: Subject 1, Period 1 (Test) profile from a public bear/WinNonlin cross-validation report, validating AUC0t (linear trapezoidal) and lambda_z (manual, 3-point) against Phoenix WinNonlin V4.0.1 output.

name: Parallel Design PK Data
description: Eleven reference datasets for parallel-group bioequivalence (P01-P11) from Fuglsang (2015). Each dataset has published reference values for both Welch-Satterthwaite (FDA-recommended for unequal variances) and classical (equal-variance) 90% confidence intervals - PE is the same for both. Coverage: small balanced (P01), small imbalanced (P02), extreme variability (P03, P11), moderate (P04), large balanced (P05-P09), large imbalanced (P10-P11). Validates the parallel branch of perform_be_analysis(): log-transformation, two-sample comparison (Welch and standard), point estimate, 90% CI on the difference of log-means, back-transformation, and the 80-125% acceptance decision.

name: 2x2 Crossover PK Data
description: Eight reference datasets for the standard 2-treatment, 2-period, 2-sequence crossover (A-H) from Schutz, Labes & Fuglsang (2014). Reference PE / 90% CI cross-validated across EquivTest/PK, SAS, WinNonlin, and R (consensus values - Kinetica diverges on imbalanced sets C and H, illustrating the need for proper validation). Coverage: A (Sauter 1992 balanced), B (Clayton & Leslie 1981 balanced), C (imbalanced via subject deletion), D (extreme range via x10^6 scaling), E (with single-subject outlier), F (n=100, non-Gaussian residual), G (n=1000 simulated, balanced), H (n=1000 with imbalance, outliers, and extreme range). Validates the 2x2x2 branch of perform_be_analysis(): fixed-effects ANOVA with sequence / subject(sequence) / period / treatment terms, point estimate, 90% CI, intra-subject CV, and the 80-125% pass/fail conclusion.

name: Replicate Design PK Data
citation: Schütz H, Labes D, Tomashevskiy M, González-de la Parra M, Shitova A, Fuglsang A (2020) AAPS J 22(2):44; replicateBE R package
description: Thirty cross-validated replicate-design datasets shipped with the replicateBE R package (rds01-rds30). Coverage spans full and partial replicates (TRTR/RTRT, TRR/RTR/RRT, TRT/RTR, TRRT/RTTR, TTRR/RRTT, Balaam, 4-sequence FDA archive datasets), CVwR from ~5% to >60%, balanced and imbalanced designs, dropouts, missing/NA period data, extreme outliers, label-switching, and the critical Method A vs Method B disagreement edge case (rds14). Validates the replicate branch of perform_be_analysis(): Method A (fixed-effects ANOVA), Method B (mixed model via lme4 / lmerTest), CVwR estimation, scaled-ABE widening (EMA / HC / GCC), point estimate, 90% CI, and the conventional vs expanded BE limit decision logic.
